Name: QuadPlanter
Author: atudota
Description:
[color=#6d9eeb][size=5][b]Quad Planter[/b][/size][/color]
Put a little planting station in a 3x3 planting area and keep its hopper stocked. Quad Planter plants all eight surrounding empty tilled tiles, including diagonals; the center tile is occupied by the machine.

[b]Getting started[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Buy a Quad Planter from [b]JojaMart for 18750g[/b].[/*]
[*]Place it, then till the eight surrounding tiles in a 3x3 square, leaving the machine in the center.[/*]
[*]Right-click the machine to open its seed hopper.[/*]
[*]Add crop seeds and close the menu. Seeds are tried in hopper slot order.[/*]
[*]Harvest normally. When a plot becomes empty, the planter uses another suitable seed.[/*]
[/list][b]Community Center route[/b]
If Joja closes, a fallback listing at Pierre's becomes available after the Community Center completion mail flag is set. This can be disabled with SellAtPierresAfterJojaCloses.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
All players need the mod. A native chest inventory and lock are used for the hopper; only the host performs automatic planting. Multiplayer behavior still needs an in-game test.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 for desktop and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later

[b]Install[/b]
Install SMAPI, extract this mod's install ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods, then launch through SMAPI. Keep the individual mod folder intact. The Nexus images and description files do not belong in Mods.

Manifest.Name: Quad Planter
Manifest.Description: Plants eight surrounding tilled plots in a 3x3 area, using real seeds from its hopper.
